§7.3 Gamma Matrix Identities

7.3 Gamma Matrix Identities

  • There are some important identities involving the traces of the 𝛾 matrices that are almost essential for computing anything QED related

  • The following are some identities that are essential to know:

  • Cyclic property of trace (general matrices):

  • Tr(𝐴𝐵…𝐶)=Tr[𝐵…𝐶𝐴]

  • Gamma-5

    Lemma 7.3.1.

    𝛾5=𝑖𝛾0𝛾1𝛾2𝛾3(𝛾5)2=1,𝛾5𝛾𝜇=−𝛾𝜇𝛾5{𝛾𝜇,𝛾𝜈}=2𝑔𝜇𝜈𝕀

  • Trace of gamma matrix × identity

    Lemma 7.3.2.

    Tr[𝑔𝜇𝜈𝕀]=𝑔𝜇𝜈Tr(𝕀)=4𝑔𝜇𝜈→Tr[𝛾𝜇]=Tr[𝛾5𝛾5𝛾𝜇]=Tr[𝛾5𝛾5𝛾𝜇]=Tr[𝛾𝜇]→Tr[𝛾𝜇]=0

  • Trace of 2 gamma matrices:

    Lemma 7.3.3.

    Tr[𝛾𝜇𝛾𝜈]=Tr[−𝛾𝜈𝛾𝜇+2𝑔𝜇𝜈𝕀]=−Tr[𝛾𝜇𝛾𝜈]+8𝑔𝜇𝜈⇒Tr[𝛾𝜇𝛾𝜈]=4𝑔𝜇𝜈

  • Trace of 3 gamma matrices:

    Lemma 7.3.4.

    Tr{𝛾𝛼𝛾𝛽𝛾𝜇}=0

  • Trace of 4 gamma matrices:

    Lemma 7.3.5.

    Tr[𝛾𝛼𝛾𝜇𝛾𝛽𝛾𝜈]=4(𝑔𝛼𝜇𝑔𝛽𝜈−𝑔𝛼𝜈𝑔𝜇𝛽+𝑔𝛼𝜈𝑔𝜇𝛽)
